visualReview.notes: Every standard frame inspected: correct open loggia sequence, polychrome arch bands, corner strengthening, relief cycles, statue niches, north entrance, projecting corbels and flat crown. The previously occluded entrance and empty loggia backgrounds are corrected.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Every shared frame inspected. White, green and rose marble tints retain metric shared texture without masonry joints across sculpture. Near panel, door, crown and loggia frames show stable normals and readable relief; far silhouette is fully framed.

geographicReview.notes: Mapped center and square wall axes match the north-up footprint beneath the projecting crown. The directed north entrance is on the cathedral-facing side; native published 84.7 m height and ground-contact base are retained.

fidelityReview.notes: Passed for the complete detailed polygonal exterior. The named sculptural artworks are represented by original geometric figures and relief motifs within the documented counts and architectural surrounds; literal casts, inscriptions and conservation stone-cut patterns are outside this reconstruction style. The recognizable silhouette, facade divisions, loggias, cladding and visible crown are complete.
